preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100.
For each test case, the number of players to select n is between 3 and 100.
The sum of squares of the values of n over all test cases does not exceed 10,000.
The number of matches organized by the program is at most 4n^2.

postconditions.description: There is exactly one way to choose n players with the highest strength that is consistent with the outcomes of the matches organized.
There are at least two possible orderings of those n players by their strength that are consistent with the outcomes of the matches organized.
